view.sqlSentence: SELECT pcategory.id, pcategory.name, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM pcategory, product, item, invoice_detail, invoice, invoice_tax WHERE pcategory.id = product.category AND product.id = item.product AND item.id = invoice_detail.item AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = 0 AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY 1,2
